description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter news application. It includes tab navigation for different news categories, an app bar with navigation actions, and a drawer for additional navigation options.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that provides tab-based navigation for different news categories, along with an app bar and navigation drawer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeScreen, including app bar, tabs, and body with error message display or news content.
